description: Multi-factor draft evaluation configuration - Team Need, Scouting Knowledge, and Hype modifiers

feature_flags.description: Feature flags for gradual rollout - set to false to use legacy behavior

team_need.description: Configuration for how team roster needs affect player evaluation

high.description: Starter below threshold OR only 1 player at position

moderate.description: Starter 65-72 OVR OR below ideal depth

low.description: Starter adequate but weak backup depth

none.description: Position is well-stocked with quality depth

round_scaling.description: Scaling factors by round to prevent early-round reaches. Lower values in early rounds mean need bonuses are reduced.

position_importance_multipliers.description: How important each position's need is. QB need is 50% more impactful than baseline.

reach_prevention.description: Minimum OVR required to receive need bonus by round. Prevents teams from reaching on clearly inferior players.

scouting_knowledge.description: Configuration for how scouting depth affects evaluation confidence

comprehensive.description: Multiple workouts, medical, interviews - full picture

limited.description: Combine data and public info only

unknown.description: No direct scouting - relying on third-party info

round_risk_multipliers.description: How much the unknown penalty is amplified by round. High picks require certainty.

team_philosophy_tolerance.description: How tolerant each philosophy is of uncertainty. Higher = more willing to take risks on unknowns.

analytics_heavy.description: Trust data over gut, comfortable with some unknowns if metrics are good

traditional.description: Trust scouts' eyes, want certainty on picks

aggressive.description: Swing for the fences, willing to gamble on upside

hype.description: Configuration for media hype and narrative influence on draft evaluation

round_scaling.description: Hype matters more in early rounds due to media pressure and fan expectations

award_signal_bonuses.description: Direct bonuses for verified awards - these represent validated talent, not just hype

heisman_winner.description: Heisman validates talent at highest level, reduces risk perception

heisman_finalist.description: Top-4 Heisman finish indicates elite production

all_american_first.description: First-team All-American - consensus top player at position

senior_bowl_mvp.description: Senior Bowl MVP - showed well against good competition

hype.max_award_bonus_description: Cap on total award bonuses to prevent stacking

team_susceptibility.description: How much teams buy into media narratives

generation_weights.description: Distribution weights when generating team susceptibility

analytics_focused.description: Data-driven teams largely ignore hype, trust their boards

balanced.description: Most teams fall here - influenced but not dominated by hype

narrative_driven.description: Teams that chase names, stories, and fan favorites

hype_talent_guardrails.description: Prevents hype from overriding massive talent gaps
hype_talent_guardrails.max_hype_overcome_gap_description: A hyped player can beat an unhyped player up to 10 OVR better, but not more

global_limits.description: Hard caps on total factor adjustments to keep talent dominant
global_limits.max_positive_adjustment_description: Maximum OVR boost from all factors combined
global_limits.max_negative_adjustment_description: Maximum OVR penalty from all factors combined

logging.log_factor_breakdown_description: Log individual factor contributions for debugging
